text:
debrief db-021
1) the a-c-t-o-r m-o-u-n-t-e-d a s-h-a-d-o-w p-r-o-f-i-l-e o-n-t-o the a-c-c-e-s-s c-o-n-t-r-o-l l-a-y-e-r and l-e-f-t a p-h-a-n-t-o-m e-n-t-r-y in the d-i-r-e-c-t-o-r-y s-e-r-v-i-c-e w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the i-d-e-n-t-i-t-y v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n c-h-e-c-k
2) the a-c-t-o-r i-n-j-e-c-t-e-d a f-o-r-g-e-d b-i-o-m-e-t-r-i-c t-e-m-p-l-a-t-e i-n-t-o the t-e-n-m-p-l-a-t-e v-a-u-l-t and l-e-f-t a f-a-l-s-e r-e-g-i-s-t-r-y r-e-c-o-r-d in the e-n-r-o-l-l-m-e-n-t d-a-t-a-b-a-s-e w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the b-i-o-m-e-t-r-i-c q-u-a-l-i-t-y v-a-l-i-d-a-t-i-o-n
3) the a-c-t-o-r r-e-p-l-a-y-e-d a c-a-p-t-u-r-e-d c-a-r-d t-a-p to b-y-p-a-s-s the s-w-i-p-e d-e-t-e-c-t-i-o-n and l-e-f-t a d-o-u-b-l-e p-r-e-s-e-n-t a-t-i-o-n e-v-e-n-t in the r-e-a-d-e-r l-o-g w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the a-n-t-i-r-e-p-l-a-y a-n-a-l-y-s-i-s
4) the a-c-t-o-r a-l-t-e-r-e-d the t-i-m-e-s-t-a-m-p f-i-e-l-d-s in the a-u-d-i-t t-r-a-i-l to m-a-s-q-u-e-r-a-d-e the s-e-q-u-e-n-c-e and l-e-f-t a g-a-p p-a-t-t-e-r-n in the l-o-g r-o-t-a-t-i-o-n s-c-h-e-d-u-l-e w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the t-a-m-p-e-r-p-r-o-o-f i-n-t-e-g-r-i-t-y c-h-e-c-k
5) the a-c-t-o-r c-l-e-a-r-e-d the l-o-c-a-l c-a-c-h-e on the e-d-g-e d-e-v-i-c-e to e-r-a-s-e the a-t-t-e-m-p-t t-r-a-c-e and l-e-f-t a r-e-m-n-a-n-t s-e-s-s-i-o-n h-a-n-d-l-e in the m-e-m-o-r-y d-u-m-p w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the d-e-v-i-c-e f-o-r-e-n-s-i-c i-m-a-g-e c-a-p-t-u-r-e
